verdict.rationale: Jules offers some oversight controls. Users can review and approve a generated plan before code changes are made (jules-docs-4), and the API notes that sessions may require explicit plan approval, which implies the approval step is optional (jules-docs-17). The optional `automationMode` field also decides whether a PR is created automatically (jules-docs-11). These are only a couple of binary toggles, not documented tiered autonomy levels set by a lead. Missing for 10: defined tiers of autonomy, per-action or per-tool confirmation policies, org- or lead-level admin configuration of these settings, and independent corroboration.
